context.transcript:
Welcome to Hirsch Automotives, Linda.
We appreciate your coming in as a marketing consultant for the next few months.
Glad to be here.
I've worked with many companies to improve their marketing strategies.
I'm sure I'll be able to help you increase your sales as well.
Wonderful.
If you need access to any of our data, just let me know.
Well, it would be useful to look at your sales figures for the past six months.
Okay.
I'll get those to you shortly.
Also, we had already scheduled a focus group for next week on Monday.
You're welcome to attend.
Thanks.
I'll put it on my calendar.
context.transcript_translation:
欢迎来到 Hirsch Automotives，Linda。
我们很感谢您能作为营销顾问在接下来的几个月来加入。
很高兴来到这里。
我曾与许多公司合作改进它们的营销策略。
我相信我也能帮助你们提高销售额的。
太棒了。
如果您需要查阅我们的任何数据，请告诉我。
嗯，看看过去六个月的销售数字会很有用。
好的。
我很快把这些给您。
另外，我们已经安排了下周一的焦点小组会议。
欢迎您参加。
谢谢。
我会记在我的日程表上的。
